_comment: Known-firing flagship. handlelike() (db.js:140-201) is check-then-act with no transaction and updates ranking through a separate read-modify-write, so concurrent votes duplicate rows and desync the counter. repeat=5 is the measured floor: 2 fires 5/6, 3 lands on a self-consistent end state and fires 0/3, 5 fires 10/10, 10 fires 9/10, 20 crosses into the unresolved-promise hang and exits 3 about half the time. Exits 2.
